current_status.stage: Approved & marketed globally; long-standing market leader in acromegaly/carcinoid syndrome/NETs, now facing its first-ever US generic competition since October 2024
current_status.data_point: Sandostatin Group FY2025 net sales USD 1,213M, down 5% YoY (Q4 2025: USD 291M, -5% USD/-7% CER) amid continued US generic erosion (Novartis FY2025 results, Feb 4, 2026)

finding_history.summary: Teva Pharmaceuticals launches the first and only generic version of Sandostatin LAR Depot (octreotide acetate for injectable suspension) in the United States, ending Novartis's decades-long monopoly on the product. Teva's generic is priced 40-50% below brand ($3,000-$5,500/month vs. $6,700-$8,500).

Novartis FY2024 full-year results report Sandostatin Group revenue of roughly USD 1.3B, slightly down for the year with Q4 2024 sales of USD 306M (-3%), attributed primarily to the new US generic entry.

Novartis FY2025 full-year results report Sandostatin Group net sales of USD 1,213M for FY2025, down 5% both in USD and at constant currency; Q4 2025 sales were USD 291M, down 5% (USD) / 7% (CER), continuing the post-generic-entry decline trend.
